## Individual assignments

Every assignment in this course must be completed and submitted
**individually**. All homework will be assigned and automatically graded
through **WileyPLUS**. WileyPLUS access is therefore a
[required course resource](resources.qmd#wileyplus).

- Launch every WileyPLUS homework assignment from Canvas. Do not search for or
  join the course separately on the WileyPLUS website.
- Homework scores are passed automatically from WileyPLUS to the Canvas
  gradebook.
- Unless a homework assignment states otherwise, it is due by **11:59 PM
  Chicago Time** on the due date. Canvas displays due dates in your time zone.
